5c3b2fb2.text: Satisfied that the small world had been ordered and that their work was done, the Titans prepared to leave Azeroth. However, before they departed, they charged the greatest species of the world with the task of watching over Kalimdor, lest any force should threaten its perfect tranquility. In that age, there were many dragonflights.
5c3b2fb2.title: Charge of the Dragonflights

70234b4c.text:
Honorable Colleagues and Truthseekers

The site's excavation continues, but it is slowed by the Troggs mentioned in my last report.  I am confident they can be dealt with, even if some of these Troggs are more aggressive than usual.

More artifacts were found recently, though in all cases but one (which I will discuss below), recent findings are of the same caliber as before - interesting, if not enlightening.
70234b4c.title: Ironband's Progress Report

fd53ac89.text:
Master Longbeard,

As you know, we Stormpikes have an eye for excellence, and so the quality of your shields is no mystery to us.

I, therefore, am keen to commission you for such a shield.  I have included specifications on the following page:
fd53ac89.title: Stormpike's Request

1092|fc807fb6.name: Captain Rugelfuss
1092|fc807fb6.text: At ease, $R.  This is no time for formalities.  With the Alliance forces under attack, the protection of the Dwarven territories becomes even more critical.  The recent Trogg uprising poses a dreadful threat to the King's land.

1139|a75e2b6f.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
1139|a75e2b6f.text: Well hello there, citizen. The name's Bluntnose, Magistrate Bluntnose, to be precise. I'm charged with overseeing the well-being of Thelsamar, and believe you me, we could always use another strong set of arms around here!

1683|c2467ddc.name: Warg Deepwater
1683|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

257446|1e35c538.name: Teo Hammerstorm
257446|1e35c538.text:
The stone an' soil speak truer than any tongue, if ye quiet the clatter in yer heart long enough to hear 'em. 

If ye've the makings of a $c, I'll teach ye.

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

258098|1605f087.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

268047|53fff4bc.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

2786|c9907ea0.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
2786|c9907ea0.text:
Welcome to Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, $c.  You may look, but do not touch.

Some of the knowledge here is not meant for the...uninitiated.

5127|dd957ca2.name: Fimble Finespindle
5127|dd957ca2.text: Your skills are coming along nicely. Soon you'll be running a leather shop of your own. I'll be glad for the help, $N. My hands are only so fast, you know? There's so much work to do!

5595|2d6411c2.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|2d6411c2.text: Fimble Finespindle has a shop set up on the northwest side of The Great Forge.  I wager he could show ye how to make some fine armor.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

6734|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Hearthstove
6734|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

9099|7cf55363.name: Sraaz
9099|7cf55363.text: This pie is so good, would you like some?

256-progress.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
256-progress.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

298-progress.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-progress.text: Oh, a progress report from the site?  Very good!
298-progress.title: Excavation Progress Report

301-progress.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-progress.text: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, $c.  I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
301-progress.title: Report to Ironforge

86585-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-progress.text: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
86585-progress.title: Banner of the Fallen

94373-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-accept.text:
Aye, the time's come, young $c. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the $c's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373-accept.title: Call of Earth

94373-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-progress.text:
Patience, lad, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys--slow and stubborn, like a true $r. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole.

Others may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear.
94373-progress.title: Call of Earth

94374-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94374-accept.text:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few $c know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
94374-accept.title: Call of Earth

94375-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94375-progress.text: Ahh, ye've returned. If ye have the stone, it means the mountain's chosen ye true. I'll give ye the totem it promised. But if ye've come empty-handed, off with ye! The path ain't for those who forget their way.
94375-progress.title: Call of Earth

96243-accept.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
96243-accept.text:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave $C. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243-accept.title: Call of Earth
